title: TIC quarterly U.S. gross external debt (as-of 2026-12-31) — the last ordinary edition before the June revision, and the level forecast's final checkpoint
source: EST: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,181 bytes) by the tic-quarterly-external-debt-2027-06-30 initial-research adjacency sweep — its 2027 table's March row reads '31' in the column headed 'Quarterly: U.S. gross external debt at end of previous quarter'. The same page's notes give the rule: 'The release dates are the last business day of each quarter (March, June, September, and December)'. Corroborated mechanically: 2027-03-31 is a Wednesday and the last business day of March 2027, offset +0 from the page's own rule, which reproduces 55 of 65 dated publications 2011-2026 at +0. Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the tic-quarterly-external-debt-2027-06-30 initial research (2026-09-09). Proposed because it is the direct antecedent of that event: it publishes the as-of 2026-12-31 position one quarter before the June edition publishes as-of 2027-03-31, so it is the last reading that can move that event's registered level forecast ($32.0tn central, band $31.3tn-$32.7tn, from $30.197tn as-of 2026-03-31 compounded at the clean recent-regime YoY of +6.00%, sd 0.96pp, n=11). It is also the third and final non-June edition before the revision test scores: 66 of 66 archived revisions carry a June release stamp, and this release should therefore revise nothing. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds: 16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is a quarter stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
